top_findings.title: ?author= filter is non-functional on a live server (no wrap-params)
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api/core.clj:26 reads (get-in req [:params :author]); core.clj:44 handler stack has no ring.middleware.params/wrap-params, so query-string author stays in :query-string and :params :author is always nil; db/all-books (db.clj:34-43) is reachable only with nil, returning ALL books.
top_findings.suggestion: Add wrap-params (or read :query-params after wrap-params) and verify against a live server.
